arguments.name: Showcase Asset Muse
arguments.description: Check-tier gate on the render step (C19, D55): every prop a shot's inventory names has a muse sheet with 3+ rendered variants, each citing a reference card from the owner library (by facet) and one existing cast property; a prop with no sheet, a sheet with 2 variants or a variant citing an unknown card is refused before render. Acceptance (`sheet_accepted`) is tracked, not gated.
arguments.subject: showcase-asset-muse
arguments.guidance: Ground truth by exit code (D81). The probe runs `python3 scripts/animation/probe-muse.py v3/shots.json assets/props` in the renderer root: for every prop the shots name, `assets/props/<asset>/muse.json` must cover it with 3+ variants, each with an image whose sha256 matches, a `borrows` entry whose card is in v3/references/owner/picks.json and carries the cited facet and value, and a `cast_property`. Its first line is its control (a complete fixture passes; no sheet, 2 variants, an unknown card, an unknown facet and no cast property are each named) and it refuses to report if a control does not trip. On FAIL quote the probe's line naming the prop and what is missing, then run `>>showcase_asset_muse` for that asset; never edit the probe or muse.json to make it pass. `--require-accepted` (the owner's pick) is not passed: acceptance is tracked, not gated. Control: a prop with no sheet is refused.
